## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this PR does, what issue it addresses, and why it is necessary.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Refactor

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository's strict TypeScript conventions.
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` and all unit tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run build` and verified zero compiler/linter errors.
- [ ] **Documentation sync verified**: If I added/removed files, changed defaults, or modified core mechanisms, I updated `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and relevant specs according to `.agents/rules/documentation-sync.md`.
